_what: The paper's citation slots: one entry per assertion the manuscript makes, with the query that asks a registry for a work supporting it. A slot is filled only if a registry returns a real record that passes verification; an unfilled slot is REPORTED, never quietly dropped.
_rule: The query is recall; the REGISTRY is authority. Nothing enters the corpus because it was remembered. Acceptance needs two criteria independent of each other (title AND year); an author mismatch is fatal. One work may hold at most one key (same DOI or same normalised title is a duplicate).
